In Los Angeles with backstage pass and parking pass.

3. Coachella music festival in Indio with camping pass and parking pass.

We need to call the functions accordingly. The function signature for concert_book_ticket: artist, location, add_ons optional. For festival_book_ticket: festival, location, add_ons optional.

We need to call each function separately. The user wants all three bookings. We can call them sequentially. The add_ons parameter expects either a single string or array? The type says add_ons?: "Backstage Pass" | "VIP Seating" | "Parking Pass"[], but that seems ambiguous. It might mean add_ons can be a string or an array of strings. We'll provide array for multiple add-ons.

Thus:

concert_book_ticket({"artist":"Taylor Swift","location":"New York","add_ons":["VIP Seating"]})

concert_book_ticket({"artist":"Red-haired Eddie","location":"Los Angeles","add_ons":["Backstage Pass","Parking Pass"]})
